decisions.note: Recorded contraction, not a free ratchet (#138). #121 removed the seven tools.expose* keys plus dev.hotReload, #136 replaced tests.enabled with the tower-tests row, and #133/#135 replaced docs.board/archive.enabled with the tower-board/tower-archive rows. The chain now continues here: the config-key surface is two-way like components, so any later increase or decrease needs its own dated decision.

#M39: one new key, review.mode (off/optional/required), replaces the deprecated review.requireReview boolean as the review policy. It is not a fifth component row: the reviewer preset row stays a capability, and the mode decides whether it is required (required) or unused (off). review.requireReview remains accepted for one release as a normalized alias, so it is a deprecated key rather than a removed one and the surface grows by exactly one.

correction.reason: Measurement correction, not surface growth: the 2.3.0 baseline recorded only define()-registered tools. tower_mode and tower_control are registered directly by index.js, so the shipped surface was always 29 (#118). The recorder in host/tool-registry.js now covers both paths.

decisions.note: The component surface joins the budget with its history. 2.0.4 shipped four top-level rows (tower, tower-skills, preset-tower-worker, preset-tower-reviewer); 2.3.0 replaced them with one tower-bundle group row that still mounts the same four sections. This is a recorded contraction, not a free ratchet: the seed stays at 4 so any further move -- including the #121 growth back to individually toggleable optional rows -- must extend this chain with a dated decision.

#121 restores the #65 policy from ADR 0005: the one tower-bundle group becomes a mandatory tower host anchor plus seven individually switchable optional rows (tower-skills, tower-batch, tower-import, tower-leases, tower-tests, tower-hmr shipped off, preset-tower-reviewer conditional). The host anchor and preset-tower-worker stay mandatory; tower_doctor and tower_recover stay mandatory with the host (#122), so they are not rows. configKeys and sections shrank in the same wave because the seven tools.expose* keys and dev.hotReload became rows.
#133: `docs.board` was a capability wearing a tuning-key costume. The visible tower-board row owns the MISSIONS.md board now; `docs.boardLocation` stays tuning. Off writes no board.
#135: `archive.enabled` was the same costume. The visible tower-archive row owns archival now; `afterDays`/`maxMissions` stay tuning. Off keeps terminal missions hot, so state keeps growing.

#134: the gate reads every shipped cordis.patch.yml, so the tower-ui row in ui-bundle/cordis.patch.yml joins the counted surface. The row was always shipped and unclassified; counting it is not new surface, it is the existing surface becoming visible to the policy.
